SELECT * FROM ( SELECT n.NOTE_ID, n.WS_ID, n.PROJ_ID, n.USER_ID, n.NOTE_TITLE, n.DONE_CONTENT, n.NEXT_CONTENT, n.ISSUE_CONTENT, n.CHANGE_LOG, n.MEMO, n.REG_DT, n.UPD_DT, u.USER_NAME, CASE WHEN p.NOTE_ID IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS PINNED, p.PIN_ORDER FROM NOTES n JOIN USERS u ON n.USER_ID = u.USER_ID LEFT JOIN NOTE_PINS p ON p.NOTE_ID = n.NOTE_ID AND p.PROJ_ID = n.PROJ_ID AND p.USER_ID = #{userId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} WHERE n.WS_ID = #{wsId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND n.PROJ_ID = #{projId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND ( p.NOTE_ID IS NOT NULL OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM NOTE_PINS px WHERE px.USER_ID = #{userId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND px.PROJ_ID = #{projId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} ) ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.NOTE_ID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, p.PIN_ORDER ASC, n.REG_DT DESC, n.NOTE_ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit, jdbcType=NUMERIC}
